achievements.sortReason: Halo CE campaign-wide completion or cleanup.
achievements.summary: Beat the par score in every Halo CE campaign mission.

steps.text: Earn a par-score clear in each of the ten missions. Use Competitive Score and avoid 0.00x skulls.

In campaign order, score above these targets: 17,000 (The Pillar of Autumn), 12,000 (Halo), 19,000 (The Truth and Reconciliation), 18,000 (The Silent Cartographer), 18,000 (Assault on the Control Room), 17,000 (343 Guilty Spark), 25,000 (The Library), 16,000 (Two Betrayals), 20,000 (Keyes), and 18,000 (The Maw). Replay missions with a lower final score.

achievements.description: Halo CE: Activate Terminal 1 on The Pillar of Autumn.
achievements.sortReason: Complete during this mission before its completion unlock; mission replay remains available.

guide.context: Terminals are visible and usable only with remastered graphics. Replay The Pillar of Autumn if you pass this terminal.

steps.text: On the bridge, find the console along the left wall with red INCOMING MESSAGE screens and a crewman beside it. Activate the console.
If a terminal cannot be activated, Save and Quit, close MCC, then relaunch and resume the mission.

collectibles.note: Replay the mission if you pass the terminal.

collectibles.note: Replay the mission if you pass the terminal.

collectibles.name: Terminal 3

steps.text: Play @loc{Two Betrayals} on @mechanic{Legendary}. Avoid killing Grunts throughout the mission; if you kill one, restart the mission.

steps.text: Start @loc{Two Betrayals} on @mechanic{Legendary} and keep the starting weapons. Do not swap either for a weapon on the ground; restart the mission if you do.

achievements.description: Halo CE: Kill every Elite on the level Keyes on Heroic or Legendary difficulty.
achievements.sortReason: Complete during this mission before its completion unlock; mission replay remains available.
achievements.summary: Kill every Elite in Halo CE’s Keyes on Heroic or Legendary.

steps.text: Play @loc{Keyes} on @mechanic{Heroic} or @mechanic{Legendary}. Clear Elites in the opening ship corridors, both coolant-pool areas, the Hunter area, the Shade position and the gravity-lift area. Check beneath the lift for fallen Elites.
Inside the ship, clear the corridors and each shuttle-bay floor. Enter the corridor leading toward the first floor to stop its enemy spawns, then kill the last Elite there.
Check the second-floor extension from the third floor. Clear the Spirit dropship team, the bridge approach and the Elites that appear after the Keyes cutscene.
On the descent, clear the corridors and lower shuttle-bay floor, including the Elites near the Banshees. Board a Banshee after the final kill. If the achievement does not unlock, replay Keyes.

steps.text: Select Halo: CE Anniversary under Campaign, then open Playlists and choose @mechanic{LASO Campaign}. Complete that playlist; launching individual missions with skulls enabled does not count.
Keep your distance from explosions and use cover. Use Grunt headshots to trigger explosions, and strike Elites from behind when possible.

achievements.sortReason: Complete during this mission before its completion unlock; mission replay remains available.
achievements.summary: Kill a Halo CE Hunter using a single pistol bullet.

steps.text: Carry the @item{M6D pistol} to a Hunter, such as the first pair on The Silent Cartographer. Move around the Hunter and fire one round into its exposed orange back.

steps.text: Near the end of @loc{Assault on the Control Room}, take a @item{Banshee} to the tower above the Control Room entrance. Land on the second of its three brackets.

steps.text: During @loc{The Maw} escape, reach the large Warthog jump. Drive off the right side to land on the side of the suspended platform.

achievements.description: Halo CE: Listen to the Thirsty Grunt talk about his eating habits.

guide.context: Using the second entrance prevents the Grunt from appearing; replay The Maw if you pass the first entrance.

steps.text: On @loc{The Maw}, pass the bridge where Foe Hammer is shot down and stay on the right of the escape tunnel.
Enter the first side passage on the right, then turn right inside. Approach the living Grunt among the Flood corpses and let him speak.

achievements.description: Halo CE: It's a sign.
achievements.sortReason: Mission-specific tasks precede mission completion; campaign-wide tasks follow the campaign.
achievements.summary: Discover the Megg Easter egg alone on Legendary in Halo: Combat Evolved’s The Pillar of Autumn.

guide.context: If the invincible Marines kill you before you reach the ceiling, retry The Pillar of Autumn setup.

steps.text: Start @loc{The Pillar of Autumn} solo on @mechanic{Legendary}. After leaving cryosleep, turn around and crouch-jump onto the yellow canister, then jump down.
Reach Captain Keyes and collect the pistol. Leave the bridge, kill the Grunts and collect the assault rifle. Return to the bridge.
Kill Keyes to summon the invincible Marines. Wait for Cortana’s announcement to finish so the second door behind their entrance opens.
Draw the Marines to one side of the bridge, then run past the other side into their corridor. Enter the second door and use your flashlight to look at the ceiling at the end.

achievements.description: Halo 2: Find and claim the That's Just...Wrong Skull on Legendary.
achievements.sortReason: Complete during The Armory before its mission completion.
achievements.summary: Pick up the That’s Just... Wrong skull in Halo 2’s The Armory on Legendary.

guide.context: Replay this mission if you leave the pickup behind.

steps.text: After the shield test, wait outside Johnson’s elevator for about 4 minutes 40 seconds. Board only after Johnson asks whether saying please would help.
Ride the elevator and board the tram. Face the building’s interior and hold the pickup button against the glass as the tram passes the skull on a crate near the end.

achievements.description: Halo 2: Find and claim the Thunderstorm Skull on Legendary.
achievements.sortReason: Complete during Cairo Station before its mission completion.
achievements.summary: Pick up the Thunderstorm skull in Halo 2’s Cairo Station on Legendary.

guide.context: Replay this mission if you leave the pickup behind.

steps.text: Leave the armory for the large room. Crouch-jump from a right-wall light to the ledge above.
Climb a diagonal beam and jump onto the overhead rail. Follow the rail to the highest platform and move the trashcan to reveal the skull.

achievements.description: Halo 2: Find and claim the Blind Skull.
achievements.sortReason: Complete during Outskirts before its mission completion.
achievements.summary: Pick up the Blind skull in Halo 2’s Outskirts.

guide.context: Replay this mission if you leave the pickup behind.

steps.text: At the first doorway, crouch-jump onto the light above the door and then onto the roof.
Enter the gap between the buildings and collect the skull beside four grenades and a spotting scope.

achievements.description: Halo 2: Find and claim the IWHBYD Skull on Legendary.
achievements.sortReason: Complete during Outskirts before its mission completion.
achievements.summary: Pick up the IWHBYD skull alone on Legendary in Halo 2’s Outskirts.

guide.context: The skull has a 1-in-7 spawn chance after the sniper alley’s Jackals load; a fixed checkpoint count is unnecessary. Replay this mission if you leave the pickup behind.

steps.text: Start Outskirts solo on Legendary and reach the sniper alley beyond the clearing where Johnson boards the Pelican. Allow the Jackal snipers to spawn.
Use the alley’s dumpster, roof and wall pipes to climb to the roofs. Cross toward the balcony doorway and search the room’s floor on the right for the skull.
Pick up the skull if present. Restart the mission and try again if the room is empty.

achievements.description: Halo 2: Find and claim the Catch Skull on Legendary.
achievements.sortReason: Complete during Metropolis before its mission completion.
achievements.summary: Pick up the Catch skull in Halo 2’s Metropolis on Legendary.

guide.context: Replay this mission if you leave the pickup behind.

steps.text: After the highway tunnel, clear the large circular outdoor area. Grenade-jump onto the base of the curved beam leading up to the towers.
Walk up the beam, jump to the left tower’s ledge and follow it to the skull.

achievements.description: Halo 2: Find and claim the Grunt Birthday Party Skull on Legendary.
achievements.sortReason: Complete during The Arbiter before its mission completion.
achievements.summary: On Legendary, collect Halo 2’s Grunt Birthday Party skull during The Arbiter.

guide.context: Replay this mission if you leave the pickup behind.

steps.text: Take the first Banshee and fly beneath the station to its lowest hanging engines.
Land on the middle engine’s upper surface. Walk beneath the connecting structure to the skull surrounded by dancing Grunts.

achievements.description: Halo 2: Find and claim the Famine Skull on Legendary.
achievements.sortReason: Complete during The Oracle before its mission completion.
achievements.summary: Pick up the Famine skull in Halo 2’s The Oracle on Legendary.

guide.context: Replay this mission if you leave the pickup behind.

steps.text: After the descending elevator, enter the two-storey glass room. Shoot out the third window on your right and the windows opposite.
Jump onto the central platform, onto a far post and then onto the column between the opposite windows. Jump through the broken window and turn left.
At the balcony’s end, collect the skull among the four Flood-infected Elites.

achievements.description: Halo 2: Find and claim the Envy Skull on Legendary.
achievements.sortReason: Complete during Delta Halo before its mission completion.
achievements.summary: Pick up the Envy skull in Halo 2’s Delta Halo on Legendary.

guide.context: Replay this mission if you leave the pickup behind.

steps.text: Reach the courtyard with the central columned structure and stationary shields. Climb the left ramp to the turret balcony and follow it to the blocked doorway.
Jump onto the blocking rock, then the thin ledge. Grenade-jump onto the left wall, cross to the dirt and climb the stone wall.
Drop toward the two cloaked Elites and collect the skull between them.

achievements.description: Halo 2: Find and claim the Assassins Skull on Legendary.

achievements.summary: Pick up the Assassins skull in Halo 2’s Regret on Legendary.

steps.text: After the first gondola ride, enter the building with two turrets. Use the cube, light fixture and ledge to reach the turret balcony.
Grenade-jump to the roof and follow the building’s right perimeter. Collect the skull in the grassy area between two cloaked sword Elites.

guide.context: Replay this mission if you leave the pickup behind.

steps.text: After the paired outdoor areas guarded by Enforcers, descend the piston into the dark Flood room with green gas.
Climb the stack of boxes to the upper landing. Search the third alcove on the right for the skull above a dead human Flood form.

achievements.description: Halo 2: Find and claim the Sputnik Skull on Legendary.
achievements.sortReason: Complete during Quarantine Zone before its mission completion.
achievements.summary: Pick up the Sputnik skull in Halo 2’s Quarantine Zone on Legendary.

guide.context: Replay this mission if you leave the pickup behind.

steps.text: At the mission start, turn around and go through the tunnel behind the Elite. Continue past the bridge on your right.
Jump onto the narrow cliff ledge ahead and follow the wall to the floating skull.

achievements.description: Halo 2: Find and claim the Anger Skull on Legendary.
achievements.sortReason: Complete during Gravemind before its mission completion.
achievements.summary: Pick up the Anger skull in Halo 2’s Gravemind on Legendary.

guide.context: Replay this mission if you leave the pickup behind.

steps.text: After rescuing both Marine groups, enter the first Valley of Tears. Turn right past the gravity lift and climb the dirt mound onto the perimeter wall.
Follow the wall, kill the cloaked fuel-rod Grunt and collect the floating skull.

achievements.description: Halo 2: Find and claim the Ghost Skull on Legendary.
achievements.sortReason: Complete during Uprising before its mission completion.
achievements.summary: Pick up the Ghost skull in Halo 2’s Uprising on Legendary.

guide.context: Replay this mission if you leave the pickup behind.

steps.text: After the room stocked with human and Covenant weapons, enter the L-shaped hallway.
Use a Ghost and a grenade jump to reach the rafters above the doorway and collect the skull. A large purple box can help with the climb.

achievements.description: Halo 2: Find and claim the Iron Skull on Legendary.
achievements.sortReason: Complete during High Charity before its mission completion.
achievements.summary: Pick up the Iron skull in Halo 2’s High Charity on Legendary.

guide.context: Replay this mission if you leave the pickup behind.

steps.text: After the Inner Sanctum, enter the second large gravity lift. Look up and hold the pickup button before passing the skull inside the lift.
If you miss the pickup, revert to the last checkpoint and ride the lift again.

achievements.description: Halo 2: Find and claim the Black Eye Skull on Legendary.
achievements.sortReason: Complete during The Great Journey before its mission completion.
achievements.summary: Pick up the Black Eye skull in Halo 2’s The Great Journey on Legendary.

guide.context: Replay this mission if you leave the pickup behind.

steps.text: After Johnson opens the control-room door with the Scarab, land a Banshee on the angled beam above that door. Climb the beam and jump left onto the curved wall.
Follow the wall’s right side, cross the small beam and climb the grassy hill. Walk up the tower support to its first landing and collect the skull from the glowing white floor panel.

achievements.description: Halo 2: Find and claim all Skulls in Halo 2.
achievements.sortReason: Campaign-wide total after individual mission tasks.
achievements.summary: Pick up all 15 hidden Halo 2 skulls.

guide.context: Use Legendary for this sweep. IWHBYD requires solo play and has a 1-in-7 spawn chance. Replay the relevant mission if you pass a pickup without collecting it.

collectibles.name: That’s Just... Wrong
collectibles.method: After the shield test, wait outside Johnson’s elevator for about 4 minutes 40 seconds. Board only after Johnson asks whether saying please would help. Ride the elevator and board the tram. Face the building’s interior and hold the pickup button against the glass as the tram passes the skull on a crate near the end.

collectibles.name: Thunderstorm
collectibles.method: Leave the armory for the large room. Crouch-jump from a right-wall light to the ledge above. Climb a diagonal beam and jump onto the overhead rail. Follow the rail to the highest platform and move the trashcan to reveal the skull.

collectibles.name: Blind
collectibles.method: At the first doorway, crouch-jump onto the light above the door and then onto the roof. Enter the gap between the buildings and collect the skull beside four grenades and a spotting scope.

collectibles.name: IWHBYD
collectibles.method: Start Outskirts solo on Legendary and reach the sniper alley beyond the clearing where Johnson boards the Pelican. Allow the Jackal snipers to spawn. Use the alley’s dumpster, roof and wall pipes to climb to the roofs. Cross toward the balcony doorway and search the room’s floor on the right for the skull. Pick up the skull if present. Restart the mission and try again if the room is empty.

collectibles.name: Catch
collectibles.location: Left tower above circular outdoor area
collectibles.method: After the highway tunnel, clear the large circular outdoor area. Grenade-jump onto the base of the curved beam leading up to the towers. Walk up the beam, jump to the left tower’s ledge and follow it to the skull.

collectibles.name: Grunt Birthday Party
collectibles.method: Take the first Banshee and fly beneath the station to its lowest hanging engines. Land on the middle engine’s upper surface. Walk beneath the connecting structure to the skull surrounded by dancing Grunts.

collectibles.name: Famine
collectibles.method: After the descending elevator, enter the two-storey glass room. Shoot out the third window on your right and the windows opposite. Jump onto the central platform, onto a far post and then onto the column between the opposite windows. Jump through the broken window and turn left. At the balcony’s end, collect the skull among the four Flood-infected Elites.

collectibles.name: Envy
collectibles.method: Reach the courtyard with the central columned structure and stationary shields. Climb the left ramp to the turret balcony and follow it to the blocked doorway. Jump onto the blocking rock, then the thin ledge. Grenade-jump onto the left wall, cross to the dirt and climb the stone wall. Drop toward the two cloaked Elites and collect the skull between them.

collectibles.name: Assassins
collectibles.method: After the first gondola ride, enter the building with two turrets. Use the cube, light fixture and ledge to reach the turret balcony. Grenade-jump to the roof and follow the building’s right perimeter. Collect the skull in the grassy area between two cloaked sword Elites.

collectibles.name: Mythic
collectibles.location: Third upper alcove in green-gas room
collectibles.method: After the paired outdoor areas guarded by Enforcers, descend the piston into the dark Flood room with green gas. Climb the stack of boxes to the upper landing. Search the third alcove on the right for the skull above a dead human Flood form.

collectibles.name: Sputnik
collectibles.location: Narrow cliff ledge near mission start
collectibles.method: At the mission start, turn around and go through the tunnel behind the Elite. Continue past the bridge on your right. Jump onto the narrow cliff ledge ahead and follow the wall to the floating skull.

collectibles.name: Anger
collectibles.location: Perimeter wall in first Valley of Tears
collectibles.method: After rescuing both Marine groups, enter the first Valley of Tears. Turn right past the gravity lift and climb the dirt mound onto the perimeter wall. Follow the wall, kill the cloaked fuel-rod Grunt and collect the floating skull.

collectibles.name: Ghost
collectibles.method: After the room stocked with human and Covenant weapons, enter the L-shaped hallway. Use a Ghost and a grenade jump to reach the rafters above the doorway and collect the skull. A large purple box can help with the climb.

collectibles.name: Iron
collectibles.method: After the Inner Sanctum, enter the second large gravity lift. Look up and hold the pickup button before passing the skull inside the lift. If you miss the pickup, revert to the last checkpoint and ride the lift again.

collectibles.name: Black Eye
collectibles.method: After Johnson opens the control-room door with the Scarab, land a Banshee on the angled beam above that door. Climb the beam and jump left onto the curved wall. Follow the wall’s right side, cross the small beam and climb the grassy hill. Walk up the tower support to its first landing and collect the skull from the glowing white floor panel.

achievements.description: Halo 2: Collect the Master Chief toy in Delta Halo.
achievements.sortReason: Complete during Delta Halo before its mission completion.
achievements.summary: Find the Master Chief toy in Halo 2’s Delta Halo.

guide.context: Replay this mission if you leave the pickup behind.

steps.text: At the bridge, take a Ghost and backtrack to the Jackal-sniper path. In classic graphics, boost up the cliff and follow the ridge around the lake to the end of the rocky peninsula.
Switch to remastered graphics and walk over the Master Chief toy.

achievements.description: Halo 2: Collect the Prophet of Regret toy in Regret.
achievements.sortReason: Complete during Regret before its mission completion.
achievements.summary: Find the Prophet of Regret toy in Halo 2’s Regret.

guide.context: Replay this mission if you leave the pickup behind.

steps.text: Enable Sputnik before starting Regret. Leave the starting building and turn right. Grenade-jump across the broken bridge, then up to the structure’s upper ledge.
Follow the walkway around the back. In remastered graphics, walk over the Prophet of Regret toy.

achievements.description: Halo 2: Collect the Arbiter toy in Sacred Icon.
achievements.sortReason: Complete during Sacred Icon before its mission completion.
achievements.summary: Find the Arbiter toy in Halo 2’s Sacred Icon.

guide.context: Replay this mission if you leave the pickup behind.

steps.text: Near the start, pass through two pistons and the room where Sentinels attack Grunts and Jackals. Cross the small bridge into the next similar room.
Grenade-jump onto the conduits on the left wall; Sputnik makes the jump easier. In remastered graphics, walk over the Arbiter toy in the far-left conduit.

achievements.description: Halo 2: Collect the Tartarus toy in Quarantine Zone.
achievements.sortReason: Complete during Quarantine Zone before its mission completion.
achievements.summary: Find the Tartarus toy in Halo 2’s Quarantine Zone.

guide.context: Replay this mission if you leave the pickup behind.

steps.text: Enable Sputnik before starting Quarantine Zone. At the final gondola stop by the Library, leave the gondola and start down the ramp.
Grenade-jump to the high ledge on the right. In remastered graphics, walk over the Tartarus toy.

achievements.displayName: Don't Make a Girl a Promise
achievements.description: Halo 2: Collect the Cortana toy in Gravemind.
achievements.sortReason: Complete during Gravemind before its mission completion.
achievements.summary: Find the Cortana toy in Halo 2’s Gravemind.

guide.context: Replay this mission if you leave the pickup behind.

steps.text: At the first Valley of Tears, turn right and climb the rocks onto the metal platform curving back toward the wall.
Go to the platform’s far end near the Anger skull. In remastered graphics, walk over the Cortana toy.

achievements.description: Halo 2: Collect the Librarian toy in Uprising.
achievements.sortReason: Complete during Uprising before its mission completion.
achievements.summary: Find the Librarian toy in Halo 2’s Uprising.

guide.context: Replay this mission if you leave the pickup behind.

steps.text: At the start of Step Aside, Let The Man Through, exit the building and climb the rocks by the cliff edge. Grenade-jump onto the cliffs; Sputnik helps with the height.
Follow the ledge right above the small Jackal camp. Switch to remastered graphics and walk over the Librarian toy in the small alcove on the right.

achievements.description: Halo 2: Collect the Rampant Cortana toy in High Charity.
achievements.sortReason: Mission tasks precede mission completion; campaign-wide and multiplayer tasks remain in their game chapter.
achievements.summary: Pick up the Rampant Cortana toy on Halo 2’s High Charity.

guide.context: Toys appear only in remastered graphics and can be collected on any difficulty.

steps.text: On @loc{High Charity}, reach the garden with a stone arch during “Please, Make Yourself at Home.” Climb onto the arch and collect the @item{Rampant Cortana toy}.

achievements.description: Halo 2: Collect the Didact toy in The Great Journey.
achievements.sortReason: Mission tasks precede mission completion; campaign-wide and multiplayer tasks remain in their game chapter.
achievements.summary: Pick up the Didact toy on Halo 2’s The Great Journey.

steps.text: At the start of @loc{The Great Journey}, take a @item{Spectre} and park the vehicle below the cliff before entering the structure.
After meeting Johnson, jump down to your parked Spectre. Drive to the water outside the control room.
Go through the water to the far right and follow the curved land bridge toward the control room. Climb the mountain behind the building in the Spectre, using classic graphics to see the terrain.
Switch to remastered graphics at the summit and collect the @item{Didact toy}. Revert to the last checkpoint if the Spectre falls.

achievements.description: Halo 2: Collect all eight Halo toys.
achievements.sortReason: Mission tasks precede mission completion; campaign-wide and multiplayer tasks remain in their game chapter.
achievements.summary: Collect Halo 2’s eight Halo toys.

guide.context: Switch to remastered graphics to see each toy; any difficulty counts. Use classic graphics while climbing to see the terrain accurately. Replay a mission if you pass a toy.

collectibles.name: Master Chief
collectibles.method: Take a Ghost from the bridge back toward the Jackal sniper path. Boost up the cliff and follow the ridge around the lake to the peninsula’s end.

collectibles.name: Prophet of Regret
collectibles.location: Behind the temple across the ruined bridge
collectibles.method: Enable Sputnik. From the start, go outside and right, grenade-jump across the broken bridge, then jump to the upper ledge. Follow the walkway behind the temple.

collectibles.name: Arbiter
collectibles.location: Far conduit on the left in the second large room
collectibles.method: Pass the first two pistons and cross the small bridge between the two similar rooms. Grenade-jump to the conduits on the left; Sputnik makes the jump easier.

collectibles.name: Tartarus
collectibles.location: High ledge to the right of the gondola exit
collectibles.method: Enable Sputnik. At the Library, leave the gondola and grenade-jump to the ledge beside the exit ramp.

collectibles.name: Cortana
collectibles.location: End of the curved metal platform in Valley of Tears A
collectibles.method: Enter Valley of Tears A, climb the rocks to the right and follow the metal platform toward the wall.

collectibles.name: Librarian
collectibles.method: At “Step Aside, Let The Man Through,” leave the building and climb the rocks by the cliff. Grenade-jump to the cliff top and follow the right ledge above the camp; Sputnik helps.

collectibles.name: Rampant Cortana
collectibles.location: Top of the garden’s stone arch
collectibles.method: During “Please, Make Yourself at Home,” climb onto the stone arch in the garden.

collectibles.name: Didact
collectibles.location: Mountain summit behind the control room
collectibles.method: Take a Spectre at the mission start and park below the cliff. Return after meeting Johnson. Drive to the control room’s water, take the land bridge at the far right and climb the mountain behind the building.

achievements.description: Halo 2: Complete every level of the game on Normal difficulty.
achievements.sortReason: Mission tasks precede mission completion; campaign-wide and multiplayer tasks remain in their game chapter.
achievements.summary: Finish Halo 2’s entire campaign on Normal difficulty or above.

steps.text: Finish every Halo 2 campaign mission on @mechanic{Normal} or higher.

achievements.description: Halo 2: Complete every level of the game on Heroic difficulty.
achievements.sortReason: Mission tasks precede mission completion; campaign-wide and multiplayer tasks remain in their game chapter.
achievements.summary: Finish Halo 2’s entire campaign on Heroic difficulty or above.

steps.text: Finish every Halo 2 campaign mission on @mechanic{Heroic} or higher.

achievements.description: Halo 2: Complete every level of the game on Legendary difficulty.
achievements.sortReason: Mission tasks precede mission completion; campaign-wide and multiplayer tasks remain in their game chapter.
achievements.summary: Finish Halo 2’s entire campaign on Legendary difficulty.

steps.text: Finish every Halo 2 campaign mission on @mechanic{Legendary}; this also grants the lower difficulty awards.

achievements.description: Halo 2: Complete a Halo 2 playlist.
achievements.sortReason: Mission tasks precede mission completion; campaign-wide and multiplayer tasks remain in their game chapter.
achievements.summary: Finish one Halo 2 campaign playlist.

steps.text: Open Campaign → Halo 2 → Playlists and finish a playlist.

achievements.description: Halo 2: Complete three Halo 2 playlists.
achievements.sortReason: Mission tasks precede mission completion; campaign-wide and multiplayer tasks remain in their game chapter.
achievements.summary: Finish three Halo 2 campaign playlists.

steps.text: Use Campaign → Halo 2 → Playlists and finish three different playlists.

achievements.description: Halo 2: Drive a Scorpion while playing as the Arbiter.
achievements.sortReason: Mission tasks precede mission completion; campaign-wide and multiplayer tasks remain in their game chapter.
achievements.summary: Drive a Scorpion as the Arbiter in Halo 2.

steps.text: During @loc{Quarantine Zone}, climb into the driver’s seat of a @item{Scorpion} as the Arbiter.

achievements.description: Halo 2: Stick a Plasma Grenade to a Stealth Elite on Outskirts.
achievements.sortReason: Mission tasks precede mission completion; campaign-wide and multiplayer tasks remain in their game chapter.
achievements.summary: Stick a Stealth Elite with a Plasma Grenade on Heroic or higher in Halo 2’s Outskirts.

steps.text: Play @loc{Outskirts} on Heroic or higher. Throw a @item{Plasma Grenade} directly onto a Stealth Elite. Replay Outskirts if you kill the Stealth Elites without sticking one.

achievements.description: Halo 2: Listen to the Cowardly Grunt's woes.
achievements.sortReason: Mission tasks precede mission completion; campaign-wide and multiplayer tasks remain in their game chapter.
achievements.summary: Hear the Cowardly Grunt’s dialogue in Halo 2.

steps.text: On @loc{Uprising}, enter the first room after the cavern and kill every Brute in that room.
Approach the Grunt hiding in a corner beside two dead Grunts and wait for his speech. Replay Uprising if he dies.

achievements.description: Halo 2: Listen to a hidden music cue in Halo 2.
achievements.sortReason: Mission tasks precede mission completion; campaign-wide and multiplayer tasks remain in their game chapter.
achievements.summary: Hear the hidden music on Halo 2 Classic’s Ivory Tower.

steps.text: Start an @loc{Ivory Tower} custom game in Halo 2 Classic. Crouch in the corner by the elevator at the back of the map and wait for the music.

achievements.description: Halo 2: Fight alongside the legendary Chips Dubbo and listen to his words.
achievements.sortReason: Mission tasks precede mission completion; campaign-wide and multiplayer tasks remain in their game chapter.
achievements.summary: Hear Chips Dubbo speak while fighting alongside him in Halo 2.

steps.text: Play @loc{Outskirts} and stay near Chips Dubbo until he speaks. Restart the mission if he stays silent or dies.

achievements.description: Halo 2: Grab the energy sword on the level Outskirts.
achievements.sortReason: Mission tasks precede mission completion; campaign-wide and multiplayer tasks remain in their game chapter.
achievements.summary: Pick up the hidden Rex energy sword on Halo 2’s Outskirts.

steps.text: In solo @loc{Outskirts}, climb onto the rooftops and cross the area with Jackal Snipers and Drones.

At the building containing two snipers, turn toward the room in the neighboring building and jump inside. Take the @item{Energy Sword} beside the Rex marking. Restart Outskirts if the sword is absent.

achievements.description: Halo 2: In The Oracle, find the holo-drone before the Heretic Leader activates it.
achievements.sortReason: Mission tasks precede mission completion; campaign-wide and multiplayer tasks remain in their game chapter.
achievements.summary: Find the holo-drone before its activation by the Heretic Leader on Halo 2’s The Oracle.

steps.text: Enable @mechanic{Acrophobia} and start @loc{The Oracle}. Reach the early room with four pillars on either side.
Fly toward the far side of the room and inspect the high opening on the right for the @item{holo-drone}. Replay The Oracle if you pass this room.

achievements.description: Halo 2: Oh, hi!
achievements.sortReason: Mission tasks precede mission completion; campaign-wide and multiplayer tasks remain in their game chapter.
achievements.summary: View the HI BEN Easter egg on Halo 2’s Regret.

steps.text: Start @loc{Regret} with @mechanic{Sputnik} enabled and carry a Sniper Rifle or Beam Rifle. Clear the Drones and Elites near the start.
Outside, face the temple to your right. Cross the ruined bridge with a grenade jump, then enter the temple’s right-hand room.
Turn on your flashlight. From the left corner, use your rifle’s scope to look at @loc{HI BEN} on the ceiling.

achievements.description: Halo 2: Spot the hippo on the walls of Headlong in classic multiplayer.
achievements.sortReason: Mission tasks precede mission completion; campaign-wide and multiplayer tasks remain in their game chapter.
achievements.summary: Look at the hippo image on Halo 2 Classic’s Headlong.

steps.text: Load @loc{Headlong} in a Halo 2 Classic custom game. Go to the building under construction in the middle of the map and look at a hippo picture on its walls.

achievements.description: Halo 2: Spot the Sid graffiti on the walls of Coagulation in classic multiplayer.
achievements.sortReason: Mission tasks precede mission completion; campaign-wide and multiplayer tasks remain in their game chapter.
achievements.summary: Look at the Sid graffiti on Halo 2 Classic’s Coagulation.

steps.text: In a Halo 2 Classic custom game on @loc{Coagulation}, enter the caves above the Overshield and active camouflage spawns.
At the cave’s arch-shaped window, look to the left at the writing carved into the rock.

achievements.description: Halo 2: View both signs in the level Metropolis.
achievements.sortReason: Mission tasks precede mission completion; campaign-wide and multiplayer tasks remain in their game chapter.
achievements.summary: See each of the Citizen Alert sign’s two versions in Halo 2’s Metropolis.

steps.text: In @loc{Metropolis}, reach the street with three Wraiths before the building where Marines are pinned down. Look for the @mechanic{Citizen Alert} sign on the road to your left.
Use remastered graphics and watch the sign change between both versions. Replay Metropolis if you pass this area.

achievements.description: Halo 2: View the smiling face in the classic multiplayer map Coagulation.
achievements.sortReason: Mission tasks precede mission completion; campaign-wide and multiplayer tasks remain in their game chapter.
achievements.summary: Look at the smiling face on Halo 2 Classic’s Coagulation.

steps.text: Load @loc{Coagulation} in a Halo 2 Classic custom game. Inspect the three rocks outside @loc{Red Base} and look at the smiling face on one of them.

achievements.description: Halo 2: View this hidden message on the classic Beaver Creek map.
achievements.sortReason: Mission tasks precede mission completion; campaign-wide and multiplayer tasks remain in their game chapter.
achievements.summary: Look at the hidden message on Halo 2 Classic’s Beaver Creek.

steps.text: Start a Halo 2 Classic custom game on @loc{Beaver Creek}. Climb to the top of the rocky walkway and move the loose boulders to uncover the hidden message. Look directly at the message.

achievements.description: Halo 2: Shoot the soccer ball in the level Metropolis.
achievements.sortReason: Mission tasks precede mission completion; campaign-wide and multiplayer tasks remain in their game chapter.
achievements.summary: Shoot the giant soccer ball on Halo 2’s Metropolis.

steps.text: On @loc{Metropolis}, follow the Banshee acquisition steps in the Scarab Lord guide. Fly the Banshee along the highway beyond the amphitheater.
Look for the building with a large section missing. Find the giant @item{soccer ball} at the bottom of the opening and shoot the ball.

achievements.description: Halo 2: Complete the level Regret with the Prophet Birthday Skull activated.
achievements.sortReason: Mission tasks precede mission completion; campaign-wide and multiplayer tasks remain in their game chapter.
achievements.summary: Finish Halo 2’s Regret with the Prophet Birthday skull enabled.

steps.text: Enable @mechanic{Prophet Birthday} before starting @loc{Regret}, then finish the mission.

achievements.description: Halo 2: Complete a level in co-op on Heroic or Legendary with the Masterblaster Skull active.
achievements.sortReason: Mission tasks precede mission completion; campaign-wide and multiplayer tasks remain in their game chapter.
achievements.summary: Finish a Halo 2 co-op level on Heroic or Legendary with Masterblaster enabled.

steps.text: Invite a co-op partner and enable the @mechanic{Masterblaster} skull on Heroic or Legendary. Play @loc{The Heretic} through to the end.

achievements.description: Halo 2: Complete a level with only the Streaking Skull active on Heroic or Legendary.
achievements.sortReason: Mission tasks precede mission completion; campaign-wide and multiplayer tasks remain in their game chapter.
achievements.summary: Finish a Halo 2 level on Heroic or Legendary with Streaking as the only enabled skull.

steps.text: Select @loc{The Heretic} on Heroic or Legendary and enable only @mechanic{Streaking}. Finish the opening cutscene.

achievements.description: Halo 2: Complete Metropolis without entering a vehicle on Heroic or Legendary.
achievements.sortReason: Mission tasks precede mission completion; campaign-wide and multiplayer tasks remain in their game chapter.
achievements.summary: Finish Halo 2’s Metropolis on Heroic or Legendary without entering any vehicle.

steps.text: Start @loc{Metropolis} on Heroic or Legendary and reach the end entirely on foot. Restart the mission if you enter any vehicle.

achievements.description: Halo 2: Complete Delta Halo without entering a vehicle on Heroic or Legendary.
achievements.sortReason: Mission tasks precede mission completion; campaign-wide and multiplayer tasks remain in their game chapter.
achievements.summary: Finish Halo 2’s Delta Halo on Heroic or Legendary without entering any vehicle.

steps.text: Play @loc{Delta Halo} on Heroic or Legendary entirely on foot. Restart the mission if you enter any vehicle.

achievements.description: Halo 2: Acquire the Scarab Gun.
achievements.sortReason: Mission tasks precede mission completion; campaign-wide and multiplayer tasks remain in their game chapter.
achievements.summary: Pick up the Scarab Gun in Halo 2.

steps.text: Start @loc{Metropolis} on Easy. Clear the bridge’s ground vehicles and allies, then use a Ghost to draw an enemy Banshee into the tunnel by firing near the aircraft.
Keep the Banshee in sight and clear the tunnel’s infantry and Marines before they destroy the aircraft. Lure the Banshee through the side passage at the blocked roadway.
Guide the Banshee into the narrow left passage and shoot off its wings. Board the Banshee as it crosses the loading zone, before the aircraft disappears.
Fly out of the tunnel and up to the suspension bridges above the city. Pick up the @item{Scarab Gun} floating over a traffic cone. Restart the mission if you lose the Banshee.

achievements.description: Halo 2: Kill 7 opponents from behind in a row without being spotted.
achievements.sortReason: Mission tasks precede mission completion; campaign-wide and multiplayer tasks remain in their game chapter.
achievements.summary: Kill seven Halo 2 enemies consecutively from behind without being detected.

steps.text: Start @loc{The Arbiter} in Halo 2 on Easy. Use @mechanic{active camouflage} to get behind sleeping Grunts.
Kill seven enemies from behind in succession without being spotted. Replay The Arbiter if detection breaks the attempt.

achievements.description: Halo 2: Complete any campaign level without dying on Normal or harder.
achievements.sortReason: Mission tasks precede mission completion; campaign-wide and multiplayer tasks remain in their game chapter.
achievements.summary: Finish a Halo 2 campaign level on Normal or higher without dying.

steps.text: Choose a Halo 2 campaign mission on Normal or higher and finish without a death. Restart the mission if you die.

achievements.description: Halo 2: Kill an enraged, berserk Brute using melee.
achievements.sortReason: Mission tasks precede mission completion; campaign-wide and multiplayer tasks remain in their game chapter.
achievements.summary: Kill a berserk Brute with a melee attack in Halo 2.

steps.text: On @loc{Uprising}, wait for a Brute to become enraged and charge, then finish the Brute with melee.

achievements.description: Halo 2A MP: In one match, steal a total of 5 occupied vehicles from opponents.
achievements.sortReason: Mission tasks precede mission completion; campaign-wide and multiplayer tasks remain in their game chapter.
achievements.summary: Hijack five occupied enemy vehicles in one Halo 2 Anniversary multiplayer match.

steps.text: Start a Halo 2 Anniversary custom game with another player on the opposing team. Have the opponent enter a vehicle, hijack the occupied vehicle, and do this five times before the match ends.

achievements.description: Halo 2A MP: Complete a game in every one of the 6 updated Anniversary MP maps.
achievements.sortReason: Mission tasks precede mission completion; campaign-wide and multiplayer tasks remain in their game chapter.
achievements.summary: Finish a Halo 2 Anniversary multiplayer game on each of the six original remade maps.

steps.text: In custom games, start and end one match each on @loc{Lockdown}, @loc{Zenith}, @loc{Stonetown}, @loc{Bloodline}, @loc{Warlord} and @loc{Shrine}.

achievements.description: Halo 2A MP: In Anniversary multiplayer, receive 2 or more Double Kill medals.
achievements.sortReason: Mission tasks precede mission completion; campaign-wide and multiplayer tasks remain in their game chapter.
achievements.summary: Earn two Double Kill medals during one Halo 2 Anniversary multiplayer match.

steps.text: Start a Halo 2 Anniversary custom match with two opponents. Kill both opponents in quick succession for a Double Kill, then earn another Double Kill before the match ends.

achievements.description: Halo 2 MP: In Classic or Anniversary matchmaking, stop the killing spree of another player.
achievements.sortReason: Mission tasks precede mission completion; campaign-wide and multiplayer tasks remain in their game chapter.
achievements.summary: End an opponent’s killing spree in Halo 2 Classic or Anniversary matchmaking.

steps.text: In Halo 2 Classic or Anniversary matchmaking, kill an opponent who has made at least five kills without dying.

achievements.description: Halo 2A MP: Blow up the Banshee or Hornet in flight while piloted, with the Rocket Launcher.
achievements.sortReason: Mission tasks precede mission completion; campaign-wide and multiplayer tasks remain in their game chapter.
achievements.summary: Destroy a piloted airborne Banshee or Hornet with a Rocket Launcher in Halo 2 Anniversary multiplayer.

steps.text: In a Halo 2 Anniversary custom game on @loc{Bloodline}, have an opponent fly a Banshee or Hornet. Destroy the occupied aircraft using a @item{Rocket Launcher} while the aircraft is airborne.

achievements.description: Halo 2A MP: Get awarded at least 10 different medals in one multiplayer game.

achievements.description: Halo 3: Activate Terminal 1 on The Ark.
achievements.sortReason: Halo 3 mission 06; finish local tasks before mission completion.
achievements.summary: Activate Terminal 1 in Halo 3’s The Ark.

steps.text: On The Ark, pass the Hunters and enter the cliffside building. Look for two holographic displays along the right wall, then enter the semicircular room across the corridor to activate Terminal 1.
Keep the terminal open until the display changes and the lower-left arrow turns red.

achievements.description: Halo 3: Activate Terminal 2 on The Ark.
achievements.sortReason: Halo 3 mission 06; finish local tasks before mission completion.
achievements.summary: Activate Terminal 2 in Halo 3’s The Ark.

steps.text: On The Ark, reach the energy bridge controls used to bring the Scorpions across. Activate the bridge, then use Terminal 2 directly behind the controls.
Keep the terminal open until the display changes and the lower-left arrow turns red.

achievements.description: Halo 3: Activate Terminal 3 on The Ark.
achievements.sortReason: Halo 3 mission 06; finish local tasks before mission completion.
achievements.summary: Activate Terminal 3 in Halo 3’s The Ark.

steps.text: On The Ark, after the sleeping Grunts, enter the room with stacked plasma batteries. Go beneath the entrance staircase and through the door to Terminal 3.
Keep the terminal open until the display changes and the lower-left arrow turns red.

achievements.description: Halo 3: Activate Terminal 4 on The Covenant.
achievements.sortReason: Halo 3 mission 07; finish local tasks before mission completion.
achievements.summary: Activate Terminal 4 in Halo 3’s The Covenant.

steps.text: In The Covenant’s first tower, stop before taking the elevator. Jump onto the dark ledge across the elevator platform and activate Terminal 4 on the left.
Keep the terminal open until the display changes and the lower-left arrow turns red.

achievements.description: Halo 3: Activate Terminal 5 on The Covenant.
achievements.sortReason: Halo 3 mission 07; finish local tasks before mission completion.
achievements.summary: Activate Terminal 5 in Halo 3’s The Covenant.

steps.text: After receiving a Hornet on The Covenant, fly to the second tower, already cleared by the Elites. Enter the main hallway and activate Terminal 5 opposite the locked door, near three dead Elites.
Keep the terminal open until the display changes and the lower-left arrow turns red.

achievements.description: Halo 3: Activate Terminal 6 on The Covenant.
achievements.sortReason: Halo 3 mission 07; finish local tasks before mission completion.
achievements.summary: Activate Terminal 6 in Halo 3’s The Covenant.

steps.text: In The Covenant’s third tower, pass the Drones and Hunters to reach the elevator. Jump onto the dark ledge across the platform and activate Terminal 6 on the right.
Keep the terminal open until the display changes and the lower-left arrow turns red.

achievements.description: Halo 3: Activate Terminal 7 on Halo.
achievements.sortReason: Halo 3 mission 09; finish local tasks before mission completion.
achievements.summary: Activate Terminal 7 in Halo 3’s Halo.

steps.text: At the start of Halo, reach the first structural beams in the snow. Follow the metal floor right, squeeze through the ice gap and cross the beam into the doorway. Turn left to activate Terminal 7.
Keep the terminal open until the display changes and the lower-left arrow turns red.

achievements.description: Halo 3: Activate Cortana's Terminal on Cortana.

achievements.summary: Activate the hidden Cortana terminal in Halo 3’s Cortana.

steps.text: In Cortana’s large circular room with the Tilt Skull overhead, drop to the basement where the Gravity Hammer lies. Activate the terminal to play Cortana’s message.

achievements.description: Halo 3: View the communique from Mendicant Bias.
achievements.sortReason: Halo 3 mission 09; finish local tasks before mission completion.
achievements.summary: Read Mendicant Bias’s hidden message at Halo 3’s Terminal 7 on Legendary difficulty.

steps.text: Start Halo on Legendary. Before the first structural beams, follow the metal floor right, pass through the ice gap and cross the beam into the doorway. Turn left to reach Terminal 7.
Activate the terminal and wait for the display to change to Mendicant Bias’s message.

achievements.description: Halo 3: Find and claim the Iron Skull on Normal or harder.
achievements.sortReason: Complete during 01 Sierra 117 before its mission completion.
achievements.summary: Pick up the Iron skull in Halo 3’s Sierra 117 on Normal or harder.

guide.context: Replay this mission if you leave the pickup behind.

steps.text: Choose Normal or a harder difficulty. Begin @loc{Sierra 117} at the mission start, rather than a later rally point.
On Normal or harder, reach Johnson’s prison area and cross the bridge. Keep right and climb the raised block by the pipes.
Jump from the block onto the balcony. Follow it to the far corner behind the projecting pillar and collect the skull.

achievements.description: Halo 3: Find and claim the Black Eye Skull on Normal or harder.
achievements.sortReason: Complete during 02 Crow’s Nest before its mission completion.
achievements.summary: Pick up the Black Eye skull in Halo 3’s Crow’s Nest on Normal or harder.

guide.context: Replay this mission if you leave the pickup behind.

steps.text: At the mission start on Normal or harder, face away from the barracks door. Climb the green metal rack, then the red beam on the right.
Jump right onto the large dark pipe. Follow the pipe to the skull.

achievements.description: Halo 3: Find and claim the Tough Luck Skull on Normal or harder.
achievements.sortReason: Halo 3 mission 03; finish local tasks before mission completion.
achievements.summary: Collect the Tough Luck Skull in Halo 3 on Normal or harder.

steps.text: Start Tsavo Highway from Mission Start on Normal or harder.
On Tsavo Highway, reach the long bridge where a Covenant cruiser flies overhead. Climb the last yellow ladder on the pipeline to the left; a Regenerator marks the spot.

Go around the metal bar and drop onto the black support below. Stand on the projecting bolted section before dropping to avoid fatal fall damage. Follow the support left, then jump across to the cliff and collect the skull.

achievements.description: Halo 3: Find and claim the Catch Skull on Normal or harder.
achievements.sortReason: Complete during 04 The Storm before its mission completion.
achievements.summary: Pick up the Catch skull in Halo 3’s The Storm on Normal or harder.

guide.context: Replay this mission if you leave the pickup behind.

steps.text: Choose Normal or a harder difficulty. Begin @loc{The Storm} at the mission start, rather than a later rally point.
On Normal or harder, reach the lakebed with the anti-air Wraith and the normal Wraith. Keep the normal Wraith undamaged until you have the skull.
Park a Warthog against the round silo on the Wraith’s side. Crouch-jump from the vehicle onto the silo and collect the skull.
If the skull disappears after the normal Wraith takes damage, revert to an earlier checkpoint or restart The Storm.

achievements.description: Halo 3: Find and claim the Fog Skull on Normal or harder.
achievements.sortReason: Halo 3 mission 05; finish local tasks before mission completion.
achievements.summary: Collect the Fog Skull in Halo 3 on Normal or harder.

steps.text: At the start of Floodgate, approach the ruined street with a scoped weapon ready. Watch the roof on the right as the radio call asks all squads to report.
Shoot the Flood Combat Form carrying the skull before the creature escapes across the rooftops. Pick up the skull from the street. If you miss the carrier, replay the opening.

achievements.description: Halo 3: Find and claim the Famine Skull on Normal or harder.
achievements.sortReason: Complete during 06 The Ark before its mission completion.
achievements.summary: Pick up the Famine skull in Halo 3’s The Ark on Normal or harder.

guide.context: Replay this mission if you leave the pickup behind.

steps.text: Choose Normal or a harder difficulty. Begin @loc{The Ark} at the mission start, rather than a later rally point.
Bring @item{Deployable Cover}. After obtaining the Scorpion, take the sandy route on the right. At the raised Forerunner structure, climb the rocks along its right side.
Go to the platform’s last support beam. Place @item{Deployable Cover} beneath the outer ledge and use the equipment as a step to reach the skull.

achievements.description: Halo 3: Find and claim the Thunderstorm Skull on Normal or harder.
achievements.sortReason: Complete during 07 The Covenant before its mission completion.

guide.context: Replay this mission if you leave the pickup behind.

steps.text: Start The Covenant from the beginning on Normal or harder. After disabling the first tower, take a Hornet and fly to the second tower, which the Elites already disabled.
Land and climb the long ramp extending over the ocean. Collect the skull at the end. Starting at Rally Point Alpha leaves the skull absent.

achievements.description: Halo 3: Find and claim the Tilt Skull on Normal or harder.
achievements.sortReason: Halo 3 mission 08; finish local tasks before mission completion.
achievements.summary: Collect the Tilt Skull in Halo 3 on Normal or harder.

steps.text: Start Cortana from Mission Start on Normal or harder.
In Cortana’s large circular room, find the rounded pillar near the fungal wall ledges on the left. Jump from the pillar up the two left ledges.
Turn back toward the higher growth with the long Flood tendril. Jump across and climb the tendril onto the roof to collect the skull among the bones.

steps.text: At the beginning of Halo on Normal or harder, follow the cave’s right wall. Take the small opening on the right and collect the skull among the rocks at the dead end.

guide.context: Ghosts do not spawn when starting from Rally Point Alpha or playing solo. If the team loses the run, replay the mission with the same settings.

steps.text: Start Halo from Mission Start with four players, Legendary difficulty and the Iron Skull enabled.
After leaving the control room, collect the four Ghosts beneath the ramp on the left. Have each player take a Ghost.
Keep the group close through the collapsing platforms and finish the escape. Watch the ending cutscene in full.

guide.context: The dialogue is random; IWHBYD increases the chance of hearing the line.

steps.text: Play The Covenant on Easy with the IWHBYD Skull enabled. Listen to surviving Grunts for the Flipyap speech. Replay encounters if the line does not play.

achievements.description: Halo 3: Destined for greatness.
achievements.sortReason: Halo 3 mission 09; finish local tasks before mission completion.
achievements.summary: Find the hidden Jason Jones figure in Halo 3’s Halo.

guide.context: A fall can be retried from the nearby checkpoint or by replaying the mission opening.

steps.text: Start Halo in co-op and reach Terminal 7 near the opening. Face away from the terminal toward the dark room with the chasm and horizontal energy beam.

Have one player stand at the edge with a partner on their shoulders. The lower player jumps into the chasm; the upper player jumps from their shoulders onto the small floor support. Move aside so the partner can respawn there.
Crouch-jump across to the next support. Turn left, switch on your flashlight and look into the far corner of the alcove to find Jason Jones.

steps.text: Load High Ground in a custom game. Enter the computer room and stand near the radio beneath the larger computer. Wait until the static gives way to music.

steps.text: Load Foundry and inspect the garbage pile in the back-right corner. Zoom in on the small hippo picture with a Sniper Rifle.

steps.text: At the start of Floodgate, head downhill toward the factory. At the corner with fire behind the fence, turn left into the narrow passage.
Look in the right-hand wall openings beyond the dead Brute Chieftain and Gravity Hammer. Inspect the missing-person poster on the floor.

achievements.description: Halo 4: Activate all Halo 4 Terminals.
achievements.sortReason: Campaign-wide target after individual missions.

steps.text: Requiem: At the terminus tower, look beneath the stairs leading to the objective elevator. Activate the terminal.
Forerunner: On the route to the first pylon, clear the symmetrical platform where your HUD distorts. Look beneath the doorway leading onward. Activate the terminal.
Infinity: Meet Lasky and Palmer. When your objective changes to finding a landing zone, turn back toward the corridor and check its far end. Activate the terminal.
Reclaimer: After the Librarian scene and retrieving Cortana, take the right-hand corridor before the elevator and follow the corridor to its end. Activate the terminal.
Shutdown: Inside the third spire, cross the light bridge left of the objective bridge. Search behind the central column on the platform guarded by Jackals. Activate the terminal.
Composer: After meeting Dr. Tilson, enter the Composer atrium and search the cave across from your entrance. Activate the terminal.
Midnight: After boarding the Mantle's Approach, reach the third enemy hallway, which has no Knights. Search the central structure. Activate the terminal.

Lure a Hunter near a platform edge, then blast the Hunter off with the explosive weapon. Replay Shutdown if both Hunters die without falling.

collectibles.name: Blind
collectibles.location: First Covenant encounter, beside the water
collectibles.method: Jump across the rocks that project over the water and take the skull from the outer rock.

collectibles.name: Iron
collectibles.method: Cross the bridge and climb the block and pipes on the right onto the balcony. Follow the balcony to the corner behind the pillar.

collectibles.name: Black Eye
collectibles.method: Climb the green rack, red beam and large black pipe. Walk to the skull at the end of the pipe.

collectibles.name: Grunt Birthday Party
collectibles.method: Before dropping into the large fan shaft, lower yourself onto the small ledge below the edge. Follow the passage to the skull.

collectibles.name: Tough Luck
collectibles.method: Use the last yellow ladder by the pipeline, near a Regenerator. Drop carefully onto the lower black support, follow it and jump across to the skull on the cliff.

collectibles.name: Catch
collectibles.method: Leave the standard Wraith undamaged. Position a Warthog against the silo, using the side facing the Wraith. Climb onto the vehicle, then crouch-jump onto the silo to collect the skull.
collectibles.note: If the Wraith is damaged and the skull disappears, restart The Storm.

collectibles.name: Fog
collectibles.location: Rooftop at the start of Voi
collectibles.method: Watch the right-hand roof as the Marines report Flood. Shoot the skull-carrying Flood Combat Form or its right arm before it jumps away, then pick up the dropped skull.
collectibles.note: If the Flood Combat Form escapes with the skull, replay the opening of Floodgate.

collectibles.name: Famine
collectibles.location: Raised structure after obtaining the Scorpion
collectibles.method: Climb the rocks onto the platform beside the sandy route. At the final support, use Deployable Cover as a step to the skull ledge.

collectibles.name: Cowbell
collectibles.location: Upper opening in the corridor after the plasma batteries

guide.context: Replay this mission if you leave the pickup behind.

steps.text: Choose Normal or a harder difficulty. Begin @loc{Sierra 117} at the mission start, rather than a later rally point.

steps.text: Choose Normal or a harder difficulty. Begin @loc{Crow’s Nest} at the mission start, rather than a later rally point.
On Normal or harder, reach the Drone pipe corridor on the route to the barracks. At the deep drop with the rotating fan, stop at the rim.
Ease off the edge, then pull back toward the ledge marked with a green arrow. Follow its passage to the skull.

achievements.description: Halo 3: Find and claim the Cowbell Skull on Normal or harder.
achievements.sortReason: 06 The Ark
achievements.summary: Pick up the Cowbell skull on The Ark in Halo 3 on Normal or above.

steps.text: Begin @loc{The Ark} at mission start on Normal or above. Destroy the Scarab, then enter the small central structure to collect a @item{Gravity Lift}.
Continue past the room full of plasma batteries. In the following sloped corridor, look for the highest opening above the bend.

Place the Gravity Lift about three quarters of the way down the ramp, facing uphill. Run down, jump into the lift and steer toward the upper opening to collect the skull. Revert to the checkpoint if the lift expires before you reach the opening.

achievements.description: Halo 3: Find and claim the IWHBYD Skull on Normal or harder.
achievements.sortReason: Complete during 07 The Covenant before its mission completion.

guide.context: Replay this mission if you leave the pickup behind.

steps.text: Choose Normal or a harder difficulty. Begin @loc{The Covenant} at the mission start, rather than a later rally point.
On Normal or harder, defeat Truth and clear the Flood on the return trip through the seven holographic rings. Stop before dropping down the final shaft.
Number the rings 1–7 from the elevator toward Truth’s platform. Jump through ring 4, then ring 6, ring 5, ring 4, ring 5, ring 3 and ring 4.
Go back to the control console. Pick up the skull beside the entrance to the light bridge.

achievements.description: H3: ODST: Complete a Halo 3: ODST LASO Campaign playlist.
achievements.sortReason: 90 Campaign-wide
achievements.summary: Complete the LASO Campaign playlist for Halo 3: ODST.

steps.text: Open Campaign > Halo 3: ODST > Playlists and choose @mechanic{LASO Campaign}. Complete the playlist rather than selecting missions separately.
Use charged plasma-pistol shots to strip Brute armor, then follow with a pistol or Carbine headshot. Give allied ODSTs heavy weapons to help clear enemies.

achievements.description: H3: ODST: Complete three Halo 3: ODST playlists.
achievements.sortReason: 90 Campaign-wide
achievements.summary: Finish three different Halo 3: ODST playlists.

steps.text: Open Campaign > Halo 3: ODST > Playlists. Complete three different playlists from that menu.

achievements.description: H3: ODST: Complete a Halo 3: ODST playlist.
achievements.sortReason: 90 Campaign-wide
achievements.summary: Finish one Halo 3: ODST playlist.

steps.text: Choose a playlist under Campaign > Halo 3: ODST > Playlists and finish every mission in that playlist.

achievements.description: H3: ODST: Complete all Halo 3: ODST Legendary campaign missions in under 3 hours.
achievements.sortReason: 90 Campaign-wide
achievements.summary: Complete the Halo 3: ODST campaign on Legendary with a total time below three hours.

steps.text: Complete every Halo 3: ODST campaign mission on Legendary while keeping the combined mission time below @mechanic{3 hours}. If the combined time reaches three hours, improve your Legendary mission times.

achievements.description: H3: ODST: View the missing link.
achievements.sortReason: 11 Epilogue
achievements.summary: Look at the Caveman during the Halo 3: ODST epilogue.

steps.text: During the epilogue, wait for Vergil to ignite Johnson's cigar. Pan left using the mouse or right stick to look at Buck and the Caveman. If the moment passes, replay the epilogue.

achievements.description: H3: ODST: Find a legendary hidden music cue.
achievements.sortReason: 08 Kikowani Station
achievements.summary: Trigger the hidden Siege of Madrigal music on Kikowani Station in Halo 3: ODST.

steps.text: In Kikowani Station, leave the second tunnel and turn right into the third open area. Fly to the small bridge rooftop beside the red ACCESS DENIED sign.
Stand at the middle of the rooftop area against the wall until the music plays.

achievements.description: H3: ODST: Face it.
achievements.sortReason: 07 NMPD HQ
achievements.summary: View the hidden graffiti on NMPD HQ in Halo 3: ODST.

steps.text: Reach the second NMPD HQ area, where Buck warns about Jackals with Carbines above.
Jump over the wall opposite the entrance door. As you fall, look back at the outward-facing graffiti on the building. If you miss the graffiti, retry from the checkpoint; Theater does not count.

achievements.description: H3: ODST: Is there a toy inside?
achievements.sortReason: 02 Mombasa Streets
achievements.summary: Look at the Web-O's cereal box on Mombasa Streets in Halo 3: ODST.

steps.text: On Mombasa Streets, enter the first building on the route to the Tayari Plaza clue. Before crossing the Grunt courtyard, check beside the courtyard door.
Look down to the right of the door, in front of the couch, and center the Web-O's cereal box in your view.

achievements.description: H3: ODST: Finish any level solo on Legendary, with no shots fired or grenades thrown.
achievements.sortReason: 04 Uplift Reserve
achievements.summary: Finish a Halo 3: ODST mission alone on Legendary without firing a shot or throwing a grenade.

steps.text: Play @loc{Uplift Reserve} solo on Legendary. Travel through the mission without firing weapons or throwing grenades. If you fire or throw a grenade, restart Uplift Reserve.

achievements.description: H3: ODST: Kill 5 sleeping Grunts on Mombasa Streets.
achievements.sortReason: 02 Mombasa Streets
achievements.summary: Kill five sleeping Grunts on Mombasa Streets in Halo 3: ODST.

steps.text: Search @loc{Mombasa Streets} for sleeping Grunts. Kill five before they wake.

achievements.description: H3: ODST: Assassinate 3 Brutes in a row on Data Hive.
achievements.sortReason: 09 Data Hive
achievements.summary: Kill three consecutive Brutes with assassinations on Data Hive in Halo 3: ODST.

steps.text: Approach Brutes from behind on @loc{Data Hive} and melee them in the back. Make three consecutive Brute kills this way. If another kill interrupts the sequence, start a new three-Brute sequence.

achievements.description: H3: ODST: Earn a Triple Kill medal with the pistol on any level.
achievements.sortReason: 90 Campaign-wide
achievements.summary: Earn a Triple Kill medal using a pistol in a Halo 3: ODST mission.

steps.text: Use the pistol to kill three Grunts in quick succession so the third kill awards a @mechanic{Triple Kill} medal.

achievements.description: H3: ODST: Kill 4 enemies with a single plasma or frag grenade.
achievements.sortReason: 90 Campaign-wide
achievements.summary: Kill four enemies with one frag or plasma grenade in Halo 3: ODST.

steps.text: Wait for four enemies to cluster together, then kill the group with a single @item{frag grenade} or @item{plasma grenade}.

achievements.description: H3: ODST: Kill 3 Jetpack Brutes with a shotgun on Oni Alpha Site.

achievements.summary: On ONI Alpha Site in Halo 3: ODST, kill three Jetpack Brutes using a shotgun.

steps.text: Keep a @item{shotgun} on ONI Alpha Site and use it to finish three Jetpack Brutes.

achievements.summary: Destroy a Wraith with melee attacks in Halo 3: ODST.

steps.text: Move close to a @enemy{Wraith} and destroy the vehicle with melee attacks rather than weapons or grenades.

achievements.description: H3: ODST: Kill a Drone with a flame grenade on Data Hive.

achievements.summary: On Data Hive in Halo 3: ODST, use a flame grenade to kill a Drone.

steps.text: On @loc{Data Hive}, hit a Drone with a @item{flame grenade} and let the fire kill the Drone.

achievements.description: H3: ODST: Swap Dare's pistol for a Rocket Launcher on Coastal Highway.

achievements.summary: Give Dare a Rocket Launcher in exchange for her pistol on Coastal Highway in Halo 3: ODST.

steps.text: Carry a @item{Rocket Launcher} to @npc{Dare} on Coastal Highway. Use the weapon-swap prompt to exchange the launcher for her pistol.

achievements.sortReason: 07 NMPD HQ

achievements.description: H3: ODST: Splatter 7 enemies with a Banshee on Kikowani Station.
achievements.sortReason: 08 Kikowani Station
achievements.summary: On Kikowani Station in Halo 3: ODST, splatter seven enemies while piloting a Banshee.

steps.text: Pilot a @item{Banshee} low over the ground on Kikowani Station. Collide with seven enemies to kill them with splatters.

achievements.description: H3: ODST: Pilot a Banshee on Kizingo Boulevard.
achievements.sortReason: 05 Kizingo Boulevard
achievements.summary: Pilot a Banshee on Kizingo Boulevard in Halo 3: ODST.

guide.context: Replay Kizingo Boulevard if the Banshee is destroyed before you board.

steps.text: On @loc{Kizingo Boulevard}, drive the Scorpion to the circular courtyard by the Kizingo Boulevard gate. Clear the ground enemies and other vehicles, leaving one @item{Banshee} intact. Remove Marines on your tank and the balcony so they cannot shoot it down.
Follow the roundabout into the back alley and leave the Scorpion halfway up the alley. Get out and lure the Banshee into the alley until its nose catches against the ground or corner as it turns.

Move behind the trapped Banshee. Fire an SMG or Beam Rifle at the pilot and hold the vehicle-entry button during the lethal shots. Keep the aircraft intact and avoid melee attacks. You must enter as the pilot dies.
