For an easier session, use bottomless ammunition and stronger player shields in the custom settings.

achievements.description: Halo: Reach: Kill 7 Moa during Winter Contingency.
achievements.sortReason: 02 Winter Contingency
achievements.summary: Kill seven Moa during Winter Contingency in Halo: Reach.

steps.text: Shoot @enemy{7 Moa} during @loc{Winter Contingency}.

achievements.description: Halo: Reach: Clear Winter Contingency without setting foot in a drivable vehicle.
achievements.sortReason: 02 Winter Contingency
achievements.summary: Complete Winter Contingency in Halo: Reach without entering a drivable vehicle.

guide.context: Entering a drivable vehicle breaks the restriction. Replay @loc{Winter Contingency} for another attempt.

steps.text: Finish @loc{Winter Contingency} on foot; stay out of every drivable vehicle.

achievements.description: Halo: Reach: Destroy the Corvette's engines & escort in under 3 minutes during Long Night of Solace
achievements.sortReason: 06 Long Night of Solace
achievements.summary: Destroy the corvette engines and every escort in Long Night of Solace in Halo: Reach in under three minutes on Heroic or Legendary.

guide.context: Taking three minutes or longer misses the target. Replay @loc{Long Night of Solace} for another attempt.

steps.text: Start @loc{Long Night of Solace} at @mechanic{Rally Point Alpha} on Heroic or Legendary.
When control returns after the corvette cutscene, boost behind the ship and destroy the engines with missiles.
Destroy the @enemy{Seraphs}, including the returning patrol, then the remaining @enemy{Space Banshees} before three minutes pass.

achievements.description: Halo: Reach: Kill 2 vehicles at once with the Target Locator during ONI: Sword Base.
achievements.sortReason: 03 ONI: Sword Base
achievements.summary: Destroy two vehicles with one Target Locator strike during ONI: Sword Base in Halo: Reach.

guide.context: A strike that destroys only one vehicle does not count. Replay @loc{ONI: Sword Base} for another attempt.

steps.text: Take the @item{Target Locator} near the start of @loc{ONI: Sword Base}.
When the two @enemy{Wraiths} outside move close together, mark the ground between them so one strike destroys both.

achievements.displayName: Your Heresy Will Stay Your Feet
achievements.description: Halo: Reach: Kill the Elite Zealot before he can escape during Tip of the Spear.
achievements.sortReason: 05 Tip of the Spear
achievements.summary: Kill the escaping Elite Zealot during Tip of the Spear in Halo: Reach.

guide.context: Letting the Zealot escape loses this attempt. Replay @loc{Tip of the Spear} for another attempt.

steps.text: At the @loc{BXR mining facility} in @loc{Tip of the Spear}, find the @enemy{Elite Zealot} carrying a concussion rifle on a platform.
Kill the Zealot before he drops to the lower facility, cloaks and escapes near the Revenant.

achievements.displayName: I Didn't Train To Be A Pilot
achievements.description: Halo: Reach: Kill 3 of the anti-aircraft batteries during New Alexandria.
achievements.sortReason: 08 New Alexandria
achievements.summary: Destroy three anti-aircraft batteries during New Alexandria in Halo: Reach.

steps.text: During the final flying section of @loc{New Alexandria}, pilot the aircraft and destroy @enemy{3 anti-aircraft batteries}.

achievements.description: Halo: Reach: Finish The Package on Legendary with the Scorpion intact.
achievements.sortReason: 09 The Package
achievements.summary: Bring an intact Scorpion to the Sword Base entrance on Legendary during The Package in Halo: Reach.

guide.context: If the Scorpion is destroyed, revert to a checkpoint before its destruction or replay The Package.

steps.text: Start @loc{The Package} on @mechanic{Legendary} and leave the @item{Scorpion} safely behind while clearing the route on foot.
Once the Sword Base entrance is open, return to the Scorpion and drive through the cleared route to the door.

achievements.description: Halo: Reach: Hijack a Banshee during the Reach Campaign.
achievements.sortReason: 09 The Package
achievements.summary: Hijack a Banshee during a Halo: Reach campaign mission.

steps.text: Start @loc{The Package} at @mechanic{Rally Point Bravo}.
Use an @mechanic{EMP} to disable an attacking @enemy{Banshee}, then hijack the disabled aircraft.

achievements.description: Halo: Reach: Flip the switches to become a Reach Racer!
achievements.sortReason: 03 ONI: Sword Base
achievements.summary: Activate both hidden Reach Racer switches in ONI: Sword Base in Halo: Reach.

steps.text: Play @loc{ONI: Sword Base} with a second player. Send one player to the rocks by the frozen waterfall, southeast of the COMM Array buildings.
Send the other player beyond the Anti-Air cannon. Find the rocky spot among trees above the walled complex on the ice.
At each spot, find the @mechanic{Hold X to open Door} prompt and activate both switches simultaneously. The players teleport to Gauss Warthogs.

achievements.description: Halo: Reach: Party with the DJ Brute.
achievements.sortReason: 08 New Alexandria
achievements.summary: Activate the DJ Brute party at Club Errera in New Alexandria in Halo: Reach.

guide.context: Keep the club enemies alive and leave the jammer intact while activating the music. If the party is interrupted, replay New Alexandria.

steps.text: Wait until @loc{Club Errera} becomes an objective. Before entering the club, fly to the hospital main building with the blue symbol.
Land on the low platform with two trees near the connecting walkways and press the green wall switch.
Return to Club Errera to find the @enemy{DJ Brute} and dancing Grunts.

achievements.displayName: Play Us a Sad Song, Claude
achievements.description: Halo: Reach: Listen to a hidden music cue.
achievements.sortReason: 08 New Alexandria
achievements.summary: Activate Siege of Madrigal at Club Errera in New Alexandria in Halo: Reach.

guide.context: The hospital switch is on the low platform with two trees at the main building marked by a blue symbol. Keep club enemies and the jammer intact; replay New Alexandria if the music is interrupted.

steps.text: Activate the hospital switch for the @loc{Club Errera} party before entering the club.
Land on the roof of @loc{Vyrant Tower}, which contains Club Errera. Press the green switch beneath the ducts beside the ramp to the metal platform.
Return inside the club to hear @mechanic{Siege of Madrigal}.

achievements.displayName: We're Gonna Need a Bigger Ship
achievements.description: Halo: Reach: Fly both the Pelican and Phantom on New Alexandria.
achievements.sortReason: 08 New Alexandria
achievements.summary: Pilot both the Pelican and the Phantom during New Alexandria in Halo: Reach.

steps.text: Finish the objectives before the final ONI Headquarters Shade-turret objective. Get a @item{jetpack} from Club Errera or the hospital.
Fly to the tower west of Club Errera. On its north side, find the hollow alcove with no floor and a switch on its ceiling.
Balance the Falcon on the ledge, jetpack up to press the ceiling switch, then return to the Falcon. In co-op, a partner can stand on the Falcon while its pilot raises them to the switch.
Fly the Falcon through the oval opening in the ring-shaped tower, about three quarters of the way up, to become a @item{Pelican}.
Hijack a @enemy{Banshee} and fly through the same opening to become a @item{Phantom}. Make another pass if a transformation does not trigger.

achievements.description: Halo: Reach: Find me in the club.
achievements.sortReason: 08 New Alexandria
achievements.summary: Enter Club Errera during New Alexandria in Halo: Reach.

steps.text: Enter @loc{Club Errera} during @loc{New Alexandria}; the music Easter egg does not need to be active.

achievements.displayName: The Humble Beginnings of Wiljax Brantley
achievements.description: Halo: Reach: Now that's a value meal.
achievements.sortReason: Complete this during Exodus before its mission-completion achievement.
achievements.summary: View a World Cuisine moa-burger advertisement during Exodus.

steps.text: During @loc{Exodus}, find the @item{World Cuisine} advertisement after the first civilians, before the elevator to @loc{Traxus Tower}. Look directly at the moa-burger advert.

achievements.displayName: Did You Major in Marine Bio?
achievements.description: Halo: Reach: Encounter the hidden marines on Exodus.
achievements.sortReason: Complete this during Exodus before its mission-completion achievement.
achievements.summary: Reach the hidden Marines location during Exodus.

steps.text: Enable @mechanic{Acrophobia} and play @loc{Exodus} to the final anti-aircraft battery area.
Fly back toward the area where you protected Army troopers from Brutes during the Falcon gunner ride. Reach the hidden Marines location there; the Marines do not need to be visible.

achievements.description: Halo: Reach: Find the hidden Banshees on The Package.
achievements.sortReason: Complete this during The Package before its mission-completion achievement.
achievements.summary: Activate the four hidden Banshees on The Package.

guide.context: Destroy both anti-aircraft guns before activating the switches if you also want to finish the mission. If the second switch times out, restart The Package.

steps.text: Start @loc{The Package} in co-op. Keep a Ghost intact in the first combat area and use the Ghost to move the crate covering a wall switch. Leave one player at that wall.
Have the other player take the Scorpion and clear the tower area. Find the green switch in the water behind the rock near the tower and activate the switch.
Have the waiting player activate the newly visible wall switch within 10 seconds. Four Banshees appear on a nearby roof.

achievements.displayName: This is Not the Greatest Lab in the World…
achievements.description: Halo: Reach: Find your way into Halsey's Lab on The Package.
achievements.sortReason: Complete this during The Package before its mission-completion achievement.
achievements.summary: Enter Halsey's hidden lab on The Package on Legendary.

guide.context: Opening the normal lab door ends the mission. Replay Rally Point Charlie if you finish the mission before entering the hidden lab.

steps.text: Start @loc{The Package} at @mechanic{Rally Point Charlie} on Legendary. Finish the defense, but leave Halsey's normal door closed.

Cross the bridge opposite the lab and turn left toward the cage. Use a jetpack to reach the glowing green switch behind and below the cage. Press the switch and return inside the boundary before the death timer expires.
Return to the door on the far right of the lab entrance. Get past the seven Elite Generals and enter the opened room, then walk to the back to reach the lab.

achievements.description: Halo: Reach: Find Data Pad on 1 Winter Contingency
achievements.sortReason: Complete this during Winter Contingency before its mission-completion achievement.
achievements.summary: Read Data Pad 1 in Winter Contingency.

guide.context: Replay Winter Contingency if you pass the pad and cannot return.

steps.text: Start at @mechanic{Rally Point Bravo}. Take the right-hand road, cross the bridge, then take the second left toward the buildings Jun marks.
Read @item{Data Pad 1} beside the dead civilians inside the circular building at the south end.

achievements.description: Halo: Reach: Find Data Pad 2 on ONI: Sword Base
achievements.sortReason: Complete this during ONI: Sword Base before its mission-completion achievement.
achievements.summary: Read Data Pad 2 in ONI: Sword Base.

guide.context: Replay ONI: Sword Base if you pass the pad and cannot return.

steps.text: Start at @mechanic{Rally Point Charlie} and enter Sword Base. On the south side of the fourth floor, look under the stairs behind the Elite carrying two Plasma Rifles and read @item{Data Pad 2}.

achievements.description: Halo: Reach: Find Data Pad 3 on Nightfall
achievements.sortReason: Complete this during Nightfall before its mission-completion achievement.
achievements.summary: Read Data Pad 3 in Nightfall.

guide.context: Replay Nightfall if you pass the pad and cannot return.

steps.text: From the mission start, follow the right-hand wall into the small cave. Read @item{Data Pad 3} between the rocks and shrubs along the cave's left wall.

achievements.description: Halo: Reach: Find Data Pad 4 on Tip Of The Spear
achievements.sortReason: Complete this during Tip of the Spear before its mission-completion achievement.
achievements.summary: Read Data Pad 4 in Tip of the Spear.

guide.context: Replay Tip of the Spear if you pass the pad and cannot return.

steps.text: Inside @loc{BXR Mining}, drop through the hole below the Zealot encounter to the room containing a Plasma Launcher.
Look across the room for three UNSC crates and a rack behind them. Read @item{Data Pad 4} on the rack's second shelf.

achievements.description: Halo: Reach: Find Data Pad 5 on Long Night Of Solace
achievements.sortReason: Complete this during Long Night of Solace before its mission-completion achievement.
achievements.summary: Read Data Pad 5 in Long Night of Solace.

guide.context: Replay Long Night of Solace if you pass the pad and cannot return.

steps.text: Before boarding the Sabre, enter the red-lit raised area left of the launch facility's control room. Read @item{Data Pad 5} by the corpse in front of the control desk.

achievements.description: Halo: Reach: Find Data Pad 6 on Exodus
achievements.sortReason: Complete this during Exodus before its mission-completion achievement.
achievements.summary: Read Data Pad 6 in Exodus.

guide.context: Replay Exodus if you pass the pad and cannot return.

steps.text: After collecting a jetpack, reach the doorway into the next building, before the order to fly to the highest floor.
Jetpack onto the construction platform above that doorway. Read @item{Data Pad 6} on the walkway beside the civilian corpse.

achievements.description: Halo: Reach: Find Data Pad 7 on New Alexandria
achievements.sortReason: Complete this during New Alexandria before its mission-completion achievement.
achievements.summary: Read Data Pad 7 in New Alexandria.

guide.context: Replay New Alexandria if you pass the pad and cannot return.

steps.text: Fly to the seven buildings surrounding @loc{Olympic Tower}, marked as ONI HQ. Find the roof dominated by a wedge rather than a flat turret platform.
Land on the north side of that roof, identified by five vents. Read @item{Data Pad 7} beside the door.

achievements.description: Halo: Reach: Find Data Pad 8 on The Package
achievements.sortReason: Complete this during The Package before its mission-completion achievement.
achievements.summary: Read Data Pad 8 in The Package.

guide.context: Replay The Package if you pass the pad and cannot return.

steps.text: Inside Sword Base's main atrium, read @item{Data Pad 8} immediately left of the door switch that triggers the cutscene. Read the pad before pressing that switch.

achievements.description: Halo: Reach: Find Data Pad 9 on The Pillar Of Autumn
achievements.sortReason: Complete this during The Pillar of Autumn before its mission-completion achievement.
achievements.summary: Read Data Pad 9 in The Pillar of Autumn.

guide.context: Replay The Pillar of Autumn if you pass the pad and cannot return.

steps.text: After the Boneyard area, enter the corridor past two dead troopers. Break the window into the second room on the right.
Read @item{Data Pad 9} on the table beside the cardboard boxes in the room's far-left corner.

achievements.description: Halo: Reach: Find Data Pad 10 on Winter Contingency on Legendary difficulty
achievements.sortReason: Complete this during Winter Contingency before its mission-completion achievement.
achievements.summary: Read Data Pad 10 in Winter Contingency on Legendary.

steps.text: Start the mission on Legendary. Immediately kill the cloaked SpecOps Elite fleeing downhill near the distress-beacon area.
Read @item{Data Pad 10} dropped by the Elite. If the Elite escapes, restart Winter Contingency.

achievements.description: Halo: Reach: Find Data Pad 11 on ONI: Sword Base on Legendary difficulty
achievements.sortReason: Complete this during ONI: Sword Base before its mission-completion achievement.
achievements.summary: Read Data Pad 11 in ONI: Sword Base on Legendary.

guide.context: Replay ONI: Sword Base if you pass the pad and cannot return.

steps.text: On Legendary, reach the communications-relay switch building at @loc{Farragut Station}.
Go behind the building and use its broken extension to jump to the cliff. Follow the cliff east to @item{Data Pad 11} and read the pad.

achievements.description: Halo: Reach: Find Data Pad 12 on Nightfall on Legendary difficulty
achievements.sortReason: Complete this during Nightfall before its mission-completion achievement.
achievements.summary: Read Data Pad 12 in Nightfall on Legendary.

guide.context: Replay Nightfall if you pass the pad and cannot return.

steps.text: On Legendary, pass the militia fighting Covenant troops and enter the next valley. Climb the rocks on the right of its entrance.
Follow the rocks and sprint-jump the large gap. Read @item{Data Pad 12} on the valley's right side before the rock bridge where Jun shelters from the Phantom.

achievements.description: Halo: Reach: Find Data Pad 13 on Tip Of The Spear on Legendary difficulty
achievements.sortReason: Complete this during Tip of the Spear before its mission-completion achievement.
achievements.summary: Read Data Pad 13 in Tip of the Spear on Legendary.

guide.context: Replay Tip of the Spear if you pass the pad and cannot return.

steps.text: On Legendary, reach the second @enemy{Tyrant AA cannon}. Climb the columns to the broken bridge and read @item{Data Pad 13} beside the damaged Warthog and dead troopers.

achievements.description: Halo: Reach: Find Data Pad 14 on Long Night Of Solace on Legendary Difficulty
achievements.sortReason: Complete this during Long Night of Solace before its mission-completion achievement.
achievements.summary: Read Data Pad 14 in Long Night of Solace on Legendary.

guide.context: Replay Long Night of Solace if you pass the pad and cannot return.

steps.text: On Legendary, enter the Sabre launch facility. Before the yellow-edged stairs, jump onto the platform to the left.
Climb the gray light scaffolding onto the diagonal gray pillar. Follow the pillar to its end and read @item{Data Pad 14}.

achievements.description: Halo: Reach: Find Data Pad 15 on Exodus on Legendary difficulty
achievements.sortReason: Complete this during Exodus before its mission-completion achievement.
achievements.summary: Read Data Pad 15 in Exodus on Legendary.

guide.context: Replay Exodus if you pass the pad and cannot return.

steps.text: On Legendary, keep a jetpack for the large plaza with Jackal snipers and Brute Captains, across from @loc{Traxus Tower}.
From the plaza's east side, fly to the zigzag struts reached by the pipes opposite the executive landing pad. Climb to the pair of vents at the top and read @item{Data Pad 15} on the right vent.

achievements.description: Halo: Reach: Find Data Pad 16 on New Alexandria on Legendary difficulty
achievements.sortReason: Complete this during New Alexandria before its mission-completion achievement.
achievements.summary: Read Data Pad 16 in New Alexandria on Legendary.

guide.context: Replay New Alexandria if you pass the pad and cannot return.

steps.text: On Legendary, turn around at the mission start and fly southeast to the first building. Descend until the @warn{TOO LOW!!! PULL UP!!!} warning appears.
Approach the recessed section of the building at that height. Read @item{Data Pad 16} at the left end of the railing.

achievements.description: Halo: Reach: Find Data Pad 17 on The Package on Legendary difficulty
achievements.sortReason: Complete this during The Package before its mission-completion achievement.
achievements.summary: Read Data Pad 17 in The Package on Legendary.

guide.context: Replay The Package if you pass the pad and cannot return.

steps.text: On Legendary, collect a jetpack outside Halsey's lab. Fly southeast from @mechanic{Wolf Spider Turret C} toward the cliff face.
Read @item{Data Pad 17} on the small ledge to the right.

achievements.description: Halo: Reach: Find Data Pad 18 on The Pillar Of Autumn on Legendary difficulty
achievements.sortReason: Complete this during The Pillar of Autumn before its mission-completion achievement.
achievements.summary: Read Data Pad 18 in The Pillar of Autumn on Legendary.

guide.context: Replay The Pillar of Autumn if you pass the pad and cannot return.

steps.text: On Legendary, reach the @loc{Boneyard} area. Climb onto the roof of the garage building, where the Scorpion spawns in Invasion, and read @item{Data Pad 18}.

achievements.description: Halo: Reach: Find Data Pad 19 on Lone Wolf on Legendary difficulty
achievements.sortReason: Complete this during Lone Wolf before its mission-completion achievement.
achievements.summary: Read Data Pad 19 in Lone Wolf on Legendary.

guide.context: Replay Lone Wolf if you pass the pad and cannot return.

steps.text: On Legendary, find the dead Spartan with a sniper rifle on the metal planks. Read @item{Data Pad 19} inside the large pipe beside the planks; the fence does not prevent reading the pad.

achievements.description: Halo: Reach: Complete the Halo: Reach LASO Campaign playlist.
achievements.sortReason: Keep this task in the Halo: Reach chapter.
achievements.summary: Finish the Halo: Reach LASO Campaign playlist.

steps.text: Open @mechanic{Campaign > Halo: Reach > Playlists} and select @mechanic{LASO Campaign}.
Complete the entire playlist using its saved playlist progress between sessions. Starting individual missions with skulls enabled does not complete this playlist.

achievements.displayName: Reach Has Been Good to Me
achievements.description: Halo: Reach: Complete a Halo: Reach playlist.
achievements.sortReason: Keep this task in the Halo: Reach chapter.
achievements.summary: Finish one Halo: Reach campaign playlist.

steps.text: Open @mechanic{Campaign > Halo: Reach > Playlists}. Choose a playlist and finish every mission in that playlist.

achievements.description: Halo: Reach: Complete three Halo: Reach playlists.
achievements.sortReason: Keep this task in the Halo: Reach chapter.
achievements.summary: Finish three Halo: Reach campaign playlists.

steps.text: Open @mechanic{Campaign > Halo: Reach > Playlists} and finish three different playlists.

achievements.description: Halo: Reach: Play a game of Halo: Reach on the 14th of any month.
achievements.sortReason: Keep this task in the Halo: Reach chapter.
achievements.summary: Play Halo: Reach on the 14th day of a month.

steps.text: Play a @mechanic{Halo: Reach} game on the 14th day of any month.

achievements.displayName: Keep Your Foot on the Pedrogas
achievements.description: Halo: Reach: Complete all Halo: Reach Legendary campaign missions in under 3 hours.
achievements.sortReason: Keep this task in the Halo: Reach chapter.
achievements.summary: Complete the Halo: Reach Legendary campaign with a combined mission time below three hours.

guide.context: The timer adds your best Legendary time for each mission; you can improve individual missions through replays.

steps.text: Complete every @mechanic{Halo: Reach} campaign mission on Legendary, solo or co-op.
Improve the slowest missions until the total of your best Legendary mission times is below three hours. Aim for each mission's par time; those targets total 2 hours 35 minutes.

achievements.description: Halo: Reach: Complete a Firefight set on Normal or Harder.
achievements.sortReason: Keep this task in the Halo: Reach chapter.
achievements.summary: Finish a Halo: Reach Firefight set on Normal or higher.

steps.text: Start @mechanic{Halo: Reach > Firefight > Custom} on Normal or higher. Set shields and ammunition to generous values, then survive until one full set is complete.

achievements.description: Halo: Reach: Get a Skullamanjaro in a matchmade Headhunter game.
achievements.sortReason: Keep this task in the Halo: Reach chapter.
achievements.summary: Earn a Skullamanjaro in matchmade Halo: Reach Headhunter.

steps.text: Play matchmade @mechanic{Headhunter}. Collect 10 skulls and deposit the entire stack together to earn @mechanic{Skullamanjaro}.

achievements.description: Halo: Reach: Won a matchmade game of Invasion in the 1st phase.
achievements.sortReason: Keep this task in the Halo: Reach chapter.
achievements.summary: Win a matchmade Halo: Reach Invasion game during the first phase.

steps.text: Play matchmade @mechanic{Invasion}. As the defending team, stop the attackers from completing their first-phase objective until the phase timer runs out.

achievements.description: Halo: Reach: Pad on the run.
achievements.sortReason: Complete this during Winter Contingency before its mission-completion achievement.
achievements.summary: Kill the cloaked SpecOps Elite carrying a data pad during Winter Contingency's opening on Legendary.

steps.text: Start @loc{Winter Contingency} on Legendary and immediately shoot the cloaked SpecOps Elite running downhill near the distress-beacon area. Restart the mission if the Elite escapes.

achievements.description: Halo: Reach: Achieve a score of 30,000 points on Lone Wolf.
achievements.sortReason: Complete this during Lone Wolf before its mission-completion achievement.
achievements.summary: Score 30,000 points in Lone Wolf.

guide.context: Dying ends the attempt. Restart Lone Wolf if you die before the target score.

steps.text: Play @loc{Lone Wolf} on Easy with scoring enabled and skull multipliers you can handle. Leave Blind off so you can see the score and boundary warnings.

Use assassinations and an Energy Sword against Elites. With Black Eye enabled, melee hits restore your shields. Move away when enemies surround you and keep earning points until the score reaches 30,000.

achievements.description: Halo: Reach: Achieve a score of 150,000 points on Lone Wolf.
achievements.sortReason: Complete this during Lone Wolf before its mission-completion achievement.
achievements.summary: Score 150,000 points in Lone Wolf.

guide.context: Dying ends the attempt. Restart Lone Wolf if you die before the target score.

steps.text: Play @loc{Lone Wolf} on Easy with scoring enabled and skull multipliers you can handle. Leave Blind off so you can see the score and boundary warnings.

Use assassinations and an Energy Sword against Elites. With Black Eye enabled, melee hits restore your shields. Move away when enemies surround you and keep earning points until the score reaches 150,000.

achievements.description: Halo: Reach: Find and eliminate one of the hidden Ranger Commander Elites.
achievements.sortReason: Complete this during Nightfall before its mission-completion achievement.
achievements.summary: Kill one hidden BOB Ranger Commander in Halo: Reach.

steps.text: Play @loc{Nightfall} and look for the golden Elite Ranger on the broken bridge near the dead militia at the mission start. Kill the BOB before the enemy disappears; restart Nightfall if you miss the chance.

achievements.displayName: Jorge Can't Have All the Big Guns
achievements.description: Halo: Reach: Use a Pelican turret.
achievements.sortReason: Complete this during Long Night of Solace before its mission-completion achievement.
achievements.summary: Operate a Pelican turret in Halo: Reach.

steps.text: During @loc{Long Night of Solace}, wait for the bomb-carrying Pelican to land inside the corvette.
Crouch beside the Pelican cockpit and press the vehicle-entry button until you enter the turret. Replay the hangar section if the turret disappears before you board.

achievements.description: Halo: Reach: Find the hidden binary signature.
achievements.sortReason: Complete this during Winter Contingency before its mission-completion achievement.
achievements.summary: View the hidden binary signature through Noble Six's binoculars.

steps.text: Hold the Assault Rifle and zoom to use the binocular view. Look at the binary signature in the visor display.

achievements.description: Halo: Reach: Splatter an enemy using the forklift.
achievements.sortReason: Keep this task in the Halo: Reach chapter.
achievements.summary: Use a forklift to splatter an enemy in Halo: Reach.

steps.text: Start a custom @loc{Courtyard} Firefight game with a Gravity Hammer, strong shields and unlimited ammunition.
Use the Gravity Hammer to launch a forklift into an enemy. A destroyed forklift also works; Gruntpocalypse provides easier targets.

achievements.description: Halo: Reach: Create a custom map using Forge World.
achievements.sortReason: Keep this task in the Halo: Reach chapter.
achievements.summary: Create a custom Halo: Reach map on Forge World.

steps.text: Open @mechanic{Halo: Reach Forge} on @loc{Forge World}. Edit the map and save your custom map variant.

achievements.description: Halo: Reach: Complete 10 assassinations on enemy players.
achievements.sortReason: Keep this task in the Halo: Reach chapter.
achievements.summary: Assassinate 10 enemy players in Halo: Reach.

steps.text: In a custom @mechanic{Halo: Reach} game, have a friend stand on the opposing team. Approach from behind and hold melee for an assassination. Complete 10 assassinations.

achievements.description: Halo: Reach: Headshot 10 enemies while they are sprinting.
achievements.sortReason: Keep this task in the Halo: Reach chapter.
achievements.summary: Kill 10 sprinting enemies with headshots in Halo: Reach.

steps.text: Use a custom @mechanic{Halo: Reach} game with a friend on the opposing team. Have your friend sprint while you score headshot kills, until you have 10.

achievements.description: Halo: Reach: Kill 10 enemies while using a Jetpack.
achievements.sortReason: Keep this task in the Halo: Reach chapter.
achievements.summary: Get 10 kills with an active jetpack in Halo: Reach.

steps.text: Start a custom @mechanic{Halo: Reach Firefight} game and choose the Jetpack loadout. Activate the jetpack while killing enemies until you have 10 jetpack kills.

achievements.description: Halo: Reach: Complete a Legendary campaign mission with 3 or more skulls enabled (Scoring Only).
achievements.sortReason: Keep this task in the Halo: Reach chapter.
achievements.summary: Finish a Halo: Reach Legendary campaign mission with at least three scoring skulls enabled.

steps.text: Choose a @mechanic{Halo: Reach} campaign mission on Legendary. Enable at least three scoring skulls and complete the mission.
Leave Cowbell, Grunt Birthday Party and IWHBYD off for this attempt. If the mission ends without credit, check the skull selection and replay the mission.

achievements.description: Halo: Reach: Complete Exodus without using any armor abilities.
achievements.sortReason: Complete this during Exodus before its mission-completion achievement.
achievements.summary: Complete Exodus without activating an armor ability.

guide.context: Take the jetpack route to the hidden Marines on a separate Exodus replay; using the jetpack breaks this achievement’s armor-ability restriction.

steps.text: Play @loc{Exodus} from the beginning without activating any armor ability. Change the armor-ability key binding if you often press the key by habit.
Finish the mission without using the jetpack. If you activate an ability, restart Exodus for a clean attempt.

achievements.description: Halo: Reach: Trigger a humorous callout on your HUD's position indicator.
achievements.sortReason: Keep this task in the Halo: Reach chapter.
achievements.summary: Enter a humorous HUD location callout in Halo: Reach multiplayer.

steps.text: Start a custom game on @loc{Boardwalk}. Find the balcony shaped like a triangle under the metal shade. Step onto the balcony so @mechanic{Make Out Point} appears beside the radar.

achievements.description: Halo: Reach: See, he IS in the game!
achievements.sortReason: Complete this during The Pillar of Autumn before its mission-completion achievement.
achievements.summary: View Master Chief in the final Pelican cutscene of The Pillar of Autumn.

steps.text: Finish @loc{The Pillar of Autumn}. After the MAC cannon sequence, turn the camera right as the Pelican enters the ship to see Master Chief in cryo.
Replay the mission ending if you miss the view. With a mouse, raise sensitivity and make quick rightward movements as the scene starts.

achievements.description: Halo: Reach: Observe the logo of a buttoned-up mining company.
achievements.sortReason: Complete this during Tip of the Spear before its mission-completion achievement.
achievements.summary: Look at the BXR Mining Corporation logo during Tip of the Spear.

steps.text: In @loc{Tip of the Spear}, inspect the logo on the outside wall of the @loc{BXR Mining Corporation} facility.

achievements.description: Halo: Reach: Access hidden UNSC radio chatter.
achievements.sortReason: Keep this task in the Halo: Reach chapter.
achievements.summary: Listen to a hidden UNSC radio conversation in Halo: Reach.

steps.text: Start a custom Firefight game on @loc{Overlook}. Go upstairs in the large two-story building to @loc{Barn High}.
Stand by the radio opposite the pair of blue water drums and listen to the conversation.

achievements.displayName: New Ways to Save a Buck
achievements.description: Halo: Reach: Hear a familiar voice on New Alexandria.
achievements.sortReason: Complete this during New Alexandria before its mission-completion achievement.
achievements.summary: Receive Buck's escort request during New Alexandria.

steps.text: Play @loc{New Alexandria} through the jammer objectives and the side missions between them.
Listen for @npc{Buck} asking you to escort his Falcon. The achievement triggers on his radio request; replay New Alexandria if a different set of side missions appears.
